messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: prod-us-west-2-gpu queue length rising rapidly (>1200 pending). cluster-autoscaler failing to scale GPU nodegroups. Error excerpts in logs: 
  - "launch template mismatch: no compatible launch template found for nodegroup gpu-pool-usw2"
  - "AttachRolePolicy failed: AccessDenied"
Please respond with 1) ack, 2) impact, 3) mitigation plan.

maria: acked. I’m oncall for eng-sre. Paging oncall-ml and infra. Starting triage.

jordan: oncall-ml here. seeing high tail latency on /v1/generate, spike in queued requests for models/llama-70b-quant. Customers reporting timeouts. Which nodegroup is targeted?

maria: gpu-pool-usw2 is target. Autoscaler logs show attempts to create nodes but AWS ASG rejects due to launch template mismatch and IAM attach errors. Queue growth started ~12:25 UTC.

samir: digging into cluster-autoscaler logs now. Found repeated error: "Could not create node: create compute resources failed: launch template version 3 not found for LaunchTemplateId lt-0abcde12345". Also see "Failed to attach IAM role to instance profile: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/CA-Role is not authorized to perform iam:PassRole"

lee: that AccessDenied explains why instances never join the cluster. If the instance can't assume the node IAM role, kubelet can't register and taints remain unscheduled.

maria: quick customer-impact check: dashboard shows ~18 customer tenants with >95th percentile latency spikes and ~40k tokens queued. We should communicate potential degraded throughput to accounts if >30m.

tina: I'm running kubectl get nodegroups via eksctl to confirm config. Command:
```
eksctl get nodegroup --cluster prod-us-west-2 --fullname gpu-pool-usw2 -o yaml
```
Output shows launchTemplate: {id: lt-0abcde12345, version: 3} but AWS console only has versions 1-2 for that LT. Looks like an automated rollout updated the ASG to reference v3 but LT v3 was never published.

samir: also noticed nodegroup has taint: "nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule" and autoscaler is trying to provision instances but ASG creation fails. Workarounds we can do quickly: 1) update ASG to point to LT version 2 (manual), 2) publish new LT v3 with correct AMI/instance profile, 3) adjust IAM to allow PassRole for CA role.

jordan: which is fastest to get nodes up? Manual change in ASG to v2 seems fastest. Can someone do it and trigger scale-out?

maria: I'll do ASG update and raise desired capacity by +4 to drain queue while infra works on IAM/launch template. Doing via console to be fastest. Will annotate changes here.

maria: Action: updating ASG gpu-pool-usw2 to use LaunchTemplateVersion 2 and desiredCapacity -> +4. ETA ~5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-bot: NOTE: policy-checker blocked LT v3 creation yesterday due to missing tag k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled=true. That explains missing v3.

lee: while you do that I'll start preparing a v3 LT with correct tags and attach role policy. Steps: 
1) create Launch Template v3 based on v2 AMI + correct user-data, tags
2) ensure instance profile role has AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy, AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly, and iam:PassRole permission granted to CA-Role if needed
3) update nodegroup config and rollout

samir: posting exact error lines and kubectl/ca logs for reference:
```
I0324 12:26:03.123456 1 scale_up.go:374] NodeGroup gpu-pool-usw2: need 4 nodes (pending pods: 128)
E0324 12:26:04.654321 1 aws_manager.go:562] autoscaling group (asg-0a1b2c3d) failed to create instances: InvalidLaunchTemplateVersion.NotFound: The version '3' does not exist for launch template 'lt-0abcde12345'
E0324 12:26:05.234567 1 aws_manager.go:611] Error attaching IAM role: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform iam:PassRole
```

jordan: good context. maria, status on ASG update?

maria: ASG updated to LT v2 and desiredCapacity set +4 at 12:33 UTC. AWS started provisioning instances. Watching nodes to join.

maria: new instances launching. Received cloud-init logs when nodes registered but one node failed kubelet join with taint mismatch error: kubelet didn't find nvidia drivers in AMI. node shows Ready? No, NotReady for 2m.

lee: that's expected if AMI missing nvidia drivers. We're launching v2 AMI which is known-good for GPU; need to check AMI id matched. Investigating.

samir: while AMI issues resolved, we can implement short-term request-level mitigations: reduce per-request max tokens for large models, optionally route smaller models, and enable model-fallback to 7B quant for lower-priority customers. Can operations toggle fallback?

jordan: yes, we can flip routing for non-enterprise tenants via feature-flag. Tina, can you coordinate with product?

tina: coordinating now. Rolling out flag to route non-SLA tenants to small-quant fallback in 2m.

maria: nodes are starting to register 12:41 UTC. kubectl get nodes shows 3 new GPU nodes with labels: nvidia.com/gpu.present=true. Taints: nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule present. Pods are scheduling onto them now. Queue length decreasing.

infra-bot: Audit: IAM PassRole still missing for CA-Role. Please grant iam:PassRole on node instance profile to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/worker-node-role for CA-Role.

lee: I created LT v3 with correct AMI and tags and published it. Will update nodegroup config to v3 and add required ASG tags. Patching now.

samir: CA logs now show successful scale events and pods being bound to nodes. Marking immediate incident mitigation as successful.

maria: current status: queue down from 1200 -> 90 pending. 95th latency back to baseline for most tenants. Some customer jobs that timed out will need manual retry. No data leak or compute errors observed.

jordan: communications: I'll draft a short customer-facing note explaining degraded throughput for ~45 minutes due to autoscaler/launch-template mismatch and that we've applied manual ASG update and published new LT.

tina: feature flag routing reduced exposure for low-tier tenants so SLA customers unaffected. Good call.

maria: oncall handoff: @jordan you take over monitoring for the next 30m. I'll start incident writeup and timeline. Add postmortem owners: infra (lee), autoscaler/ca (samir), oncall (maria).

jordan: taking over. I'll keep watch and escalate if queue starts climbing again.

samir: follow-up actions I’ll own: 1) add CI check to ensure LT versions referenced in nodegroup configs exist before rollout; 2) add iam:PassRole check to deployment pipeline; 3) add autoscaler alert for repeated LaunchTemplateVersion.NotFound.

lee: infra follow-ups: 1) audit AMI publishing process; 2) ensure GPU AMI includes driver smoke test; 3) add autoscaling tag validation.

maria: incident closed for paging at 13:25 UTC. Creating postmortem and linking alert graphs. Thanks all. :tada:

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigated. severity: P2. duration: 60m. pages: 2. root causes: launch template version mismatch + missing iam:PassRole. followups assigned.
